players.club_competitions_2025_26: Premier League

Capped for England at under-21 level, he switched allegiance to Scotland in 2023 and was at Euro 2024; he arrives at the World Cup wearing the Scotland No 1 shirt.

Fit again and competing for a starting berth, the versatile defender brings Premier League pedigree to Scotland's back line.

Scotland's captain and leader, he heads to the World Cup having confirmed his Liverpool departure.
